clock_quality.rule: The exchange publishes the Bhav Copy after the session closes and we did not capture it live, so every row is published with unknown latency. available_utc is the session's close instant from mcx_sessions (evening close 23:30 or 23:55 IST per the hours circular in force, the 17:00 morning close on morning-only days, the Muhurat or budget-session close where one applies); for a session whose evening close no retained circular states, the later published close (23:55 IST) is used so the instant is never earlier than the true close.

name: mcx_daily
notes: One row per (session_date, contract_id) for every FUTCOM contract the exchange listed that day, all commodities, whole curve.
Units are native: INR per MCX quotation unit (GOLD per 10 g, SILVER per kg, COPPER per kg, CRUDEOIL per barrel; see mcx_contract_specs.json).
The Bhav Copy has a single closing price column (`Close`); it is the daily settlement price. `settlement` carries it for every row, `close` only where the contract traded.
Zero `Open`/`High`/`Low` in the exchange file mean no trade and are stored as null, never as 0.
`open_interest_change` is derived here from consecutive sessions; the exchange file does not publish it.
